authority_rule: task-specific PM fallback only when Framework has no applicable path

course_root.description: Algebra repository root; teacher dashboard lives at the same level as index.html.
course_root.link_rule: All internal course links are relative from course root: no leading slash, domain, or repo name.
portable_hosts: local http server from algebra folder

path_resolution_rules: Resolve resource-relative CSS/image/script links from the final deployed resource location, not from a staging ZIP root.
Do not report an intentional course-root dependency as broken merely because the isolated ZIP does not contain the shared root folder.
Do not invent a wrapper directory that changes the dashboard path depth.
Bank ZIP internal root for Unit U is exactly unit{U}/ so extraction into banks/ produces banks/unit{U}/unit{U}.html.
Use the exact current dashboard roots; notably performance_task___5134zrt/ and quick_check____htq5855/ are intentionally obscured.
The older performance_task/, quick_check/, and ideas/ dashboard routes are retired; preserve teacher-live legacy content if it exists, but do not generate new links to those obsolete roots.
Tarsia/Blooket _practice_3 naming is a dashboard/file-structure convention and does not imply derivation from Practice Set 3.
The Bank review view lives beside the normal Bank at banks/unit{U}/unit{U}_review.html and is linked only from the Bank; do not add a dashboard button/column for it.
Practice packages copy canonical Bank figures and do not package graph tools or Practice graph-generator scripts.
Activity hub internal activity-name links are same-document anchors inside u{U}_{S}_act1.html; they are not separate direction files.
Recurring/assessment Unit ZIPs are course-root-relative drop-in trees and do not duplicate shared root CSS unless explicitly requested.

Performance Tasks + Quick Checks all-course ZIPs contain exactly the two obscured resource roots. Their CSS remains a shared course-root dependency at css/performance_task.css and css/quick_check.css; section HTML links ../../css/... and the isolated resource ZIP must not duplicate those stylesheets.

Quick Check section folders contain exactly ONE HTML file at u{U}_{S}_quick_check.html; that single file contains all six complete printable versions. Separate _v2 through _v6 HTML files are prohibited.
For Algebra Performance Task/Quick Check returned ZIPs, any .css file found inside performance_task___5134zrt/ or quick_check____htq5855/ is a packaging failure; CSS lives only at course-root css/.

preserve_on_bank_upgrade: legacy ideas/ content if present, even though it is no longer linked from the current dashboard
live_course_paths.rule: A bank/course refresh must not overwrite teacher-live content at these paths unless explicitly requested.

notes: Current dashboard removed Future Resource/ideas links and obscured Performance Task and Quick Check roots. External top-resource and Discourse & Reflection URLs remain navigation configuration, not canonical curriculum-content authority.

shared_css_authoring_reference.rule: Use the embedded bank.css as the exact authoring/DOM compatibility reference. Do not package a CSS copy inside a Bank ZIP; production HTML links to the shared root css/bank.css.
shared_css_authoring_reference.base_css: Required shared dependency at css/base.css; not replaced by this Framework update.
shared_css_authoring_reference.notes_css_rule: Current notes.css is stable and external. Base Notes PM + contracts/notes_visual_contract.json preserve the allowed class/link contract; ordinary Notes builds must not package or redesign CSS.
shared_css_authoring_reference.practice_set_css_rule: Universal practice_set.css is shared across all courses. This Framework stores a byte-identical reference mirror of the Base Practice Starter canonical CSS; ordinary Practice builds link to deployed css/practice_set.css and do not package or redesign it.
shared_css_authoring_reference.activities_css_rule: Activities link shared css/base.css plus exactly one Framework-selected Activity stylesheet. New projector uses css/activities.css; stations uses css/activity_stations.css; Find Someone Who uses css/activity_find_someone_who.css. Do not package CSS inside Unit Activities ZIPs.
shared_css_authoring_reference.warmup_css_rule: Notability-first Warm-Up reference. Load after base.css; preserve tested fixed card geometry.
shared_css_authoring_reference.exit_css_rule: Projector-only Exit Ticket reference; one full-screen 2x2 ticket per viewport.
shared_css_authoring_reference.summative_math_css_rule: Algebra uses the constructed-response math Summative family. Do not use the Physics bubble-sheet stylesheet in Algebra.
shared_css_authoring_reference.performance_task_css_rule: Approved Algebra Performance Task shell. Deploy once at course-root css/performance_task.css; all Performance Task student/teacher HTML links ../../css/performance_task.css. Do not package a duplicate inside performance_task___5134zrt/.
shared_css_authoring_reference.quick_check_css_rule: Universal print-first Quick Check shell. Deploy once at course-root css/quick_check.css; Quick Check section HTML links ../../css/quick_check.css. Do not package a duplicate inside quick_check____htq5855/.
